name: Korea Computer Center (KCC)
notes: State-administered IT research center/enterprise headquartered in Mangyongdae-guyok, Pyongyang, founded 1990. The country's primary computing facility: operates the Kwangmyong national intranet and Naenara web portal, plus 8 R&D centers and 11 regional information centers; employs 1000+ staff. Not a commercial colocation datacenter; no public MW capacity data.

name: Star Joint Venture Co. / Pyongyang Internet Communication Bureau
developer: Ministry of Post and Telecommunications (DPRK) / Loxley Pacific (Thailand) JV
notes: North Korea's sole internet service provider and international gateway, headquartered in Pyongyang; Pyongyang Internet Communication Bureau ground-breaking Nov 2015. Carries all DPRK international traffic via China Unicom (with Intelsat satellite and TransTeleCom backup links); houses the country's international gateway/server infrastructure. Telecommunication gateway facility rather than a commercial datacenter.

name: Pyongyang Information Center
notes: State-run North Korean IT venture company in Pyongyang developing software and websites (including work for foreign clients), one of several state IT entities besides KCC and Nosotek. Mentioned only in aggregate secondary sources; not confirmed as a physical commercial datacenter facility.
